WITH sentiment_trans_trader AS (
  SELECT 
    s.optvolrt,
    t.transreg,
    tr.tradekind
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  WHERE s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg
  FROM sentiment_trans_trader
),
pair_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    transreg,
    tradekind,
    AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentiment_trans_trader
  GROUP BY transreg, tradekind
),
pairs_with_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    p.transreg,
    p.tradekind,
    p.avg_optvolrt,
    p.avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg as deviation
  FROM pair_avgs p
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM pairs_with_deviation
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.transreg,
    p.tradekind,
    p.avg_optvolrt,
    p.deviation,
    ts.type_avg_deviation
  FROM pairs_with_deviation p
  INNER JOIN type_stats ts ON p.tradekind = ts.tradekind
  WHERE p.deviation > ts.type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt),
  AVG(deviation),
  AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation)
FROM filtered_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind;
